mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDPC1 acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ rise in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals healthy supply-side momentum that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 55% of days when INDPRO > 12mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is also accelerating, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months when FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both rising.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are declining and retail sales (RSAFS) are also weakening, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when HOUST and RSAFS are both declining.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing faster than its 12-month moving average, it signals a strengthening labor market that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 55% of days when PAYEMS growth > 12mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is also above its 12-month moving average, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of days when FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL > 12mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is contracting on a quarter-over-quarter basis, it signals an economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of quarters when QoQ GDPC1 growth is negative.
